text.en: 1. This Order is the Co‑operative Societies (NTUC Enterprise Co‑operative Limited — Exemption under Section 97) Order 2021 and comes into operation on 19 August 2021.

2.—(1) NTUC Enterprise Co‑operative Limited (called in this paragraph NEC), a secondary society, is exempt from the requirement in section 39(2) of the Act that membership in a secondary society is to be restricted to registered co‑operative societies, trade unions and platform work associations, to the extent provided in sub‑paragraph (2).
[S 964/2024 wef 01/01/2025]
(2) NEC may admit NTUC Foundation Limited as a member of NEC, despite that NTUC Foundation Limited is not a registered co-operative society, trade union or platform work association.
[S 964/2024 wef 01/01/2025]
